verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI has a dedicated MCP client docs page stating it can act as an MCP client, connecting to MCP servers to use their tools during an agent run. The agent model also treats toolsets as a first-class container alongside function tools, which fits plugging in external tool sources. Missing for 10: details on supported transports and configuration (e.g. stdio/HTTP, tool filtering), and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP use.
